pages.title: Mr. Krabs Admiring His Framed First Dollar in His Anchor House Coloring Page
pages.description: Mr. Krabs admires his framed first dollar inside his anchor house in this printable coloring page, with a round porthole and seashell nearby. The bill has a shell emblem, while wall boards, frame studs, and the barrel table add smaller sections around the broad character shapes on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Mr. Krabs Playing the World's Smallest Violin Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Mr. Krabs playing the world's smallest violin, holding the tiny instrument in one claw and drawing its bow with the other. His drooping eyebrows and downturned mouth contrast with his large eyestalks. The coloring sheet has an empty background, with fine violin strings beside broad clothing and claw shapes.

pages.title: Mr. Krabs Celebrating His One Millionth Dollar at the Krusty Krab Coloring Page
pages.description: Mr. Krabs celebrates his one millionth dollar at the Krusty Krab in this printable coloring page, raising a bill as confetti falls around him. His open smile and lifted claws fill the foreground. Floorboards, a barrel stool, a round table, and the porthole door add restaurant details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Mr. Krabs Wearing a Crown on a Throne Made of Money Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Mr. Krabs wearing a pointed crown on a throne made of money, surrounded by bundled bills and tall coin stacks. His claws rest on the armrests, with both feet planted on more bundles. The coloring sheet combines broad clothing shapes with closely spaced banknote edges and circular crown decorations.

pages.title: Mr. Krabs Talking to Animated Coins and Dollar Bills Coloring Page
pages.description: Mr. Krabs talks to animated coins and dollar bills in this printable coloring page, smiling broadly and lifting one claw toward the floating money. Two coins and two bills have expressive faces, with short lines beside them. Their simple outlines and the open floor create spacious areas throughout this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Mr. Krabs Giving SpongeBob an Employee of the Month Award Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Mr. Krabs giving SpongeBob an employee of the month award, holding a two-handled trophy decorated with a large outlined star. SpongeBob clasps his hands beside the cup while both characters smile. A framed flower and wooden floorboards provide a simple indoor setting for this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Mr. Krabs as Krabby the Clown at the Krabby Land Playground Coloring Page
pages.description: Mr. Krabs appears as Krabby the Clown at the Krabby Land playground in this printable coloring page, wearing a round nose and spotted necktie. Curly hair and an upturned mustache frame his smiling face. A slide, swing set, small rocks, and sparse sea plants give the coloring sheet a lightly detailed background.

pages.title: Mr. Krabs Chasing Plankton Out of the Krusty Krab Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Mr. Krabs chasing Plankton out of the Krusty Krab, with raised claws and an angry expression beside the open door. Plankton runs ahead with droplets around his head. The coloring sheet includes a rope-patterned window, a porthole door, and long floorboards that follow the direction of the chase.

pages.title: Young Mr. Krabs and Young Plankton Making Burgers Together Coloring Page
pages.description: Young Mr. Krabs and young Plankton make burgers together in this printable coloring page, with a spatula, a lettuce bowl, and a small wooden table. Plankton stands on a stool to place a leaf on the burger. The coloring sheet includes patches on Krabs's shirt and clear open spaces around the cooking scene.

pages.title: Mr. Krabs Giving Pearl Her Allowance Outside the Shopping Mall Coloring Page
pages.description: Mr. Krabs gives Pearl her allowance outside the shopping mall in this printable coloring page, passing a single bill toward her open hand by the entrance. Pearl wears a bow, a short dress, and laced shoes. The coloring sheet pairs the two large character outlines with simple glass-door panels and a blank overhead sign.

pages.title: Mr. Krabs Bringing Pearl a Birthday Cake Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Mr. Krabs bringing Pearl a birthday cake with three lit candles, while a single balloon floats beside the smiling pair. Pearl clasps her hands and wears a bow with her party dress. Scalloped icing, striped candles, and the cake's round platter add small details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Mr. Krabs Bargaining with the Flying Dutchman Aboard a Ghost Ship Coloring Page
pages.description: Mr. Krabs bargains with the Flying Dutchman aboard a ghost ship in this printable coloring page, offering a coin while the pirate folds his arms. The Dutchman's beard, torn hat, and curling ghostly tail dominate one side. Rope ladders, a mast, ragged sails, and a barrel create a detailed shipboard setting on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Young Mr. Krabs Wearing His Navy Sailor Uniform on a Ship Coloring Page
pages.description: Young Mr. Krabs wears his navy sailor uniform on a ship in this printable coloring page, resting one claw on the large steering wheel. His sailor cap, striped collar, and tied neckerchief distinguish the outfit. The coloring sheet includes open shirt panels, thick wheel spokes, deck boards, and a simple railing behind him.

pages.title: Mr. Krabs as the Pirate Superhero Sir Pinch-a-lot Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page presents Mr. Krabs as the pirate superhero Sir Pinch-a-lot, wearing a broad hat, long buttoned coat, and shoes with square buckles. He poses on a ship's deck with one claw raised. A mast, rope ladder, barrel, and distant waves frame the detailed costume on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Mr. Krabs as the Kamp Koral Camp Director Outside the Camp Kitchen Coloring Page
pages.description: Mr. Krabs stands outside the camp kitchen as the Kamp Koral camp director in this printable coloring page, waving beside the open wooden doorway. He wears a broad-brimmed hat and a uniform shirt with buttoned pocket flaps. A lidded cooking pot, wall planks, and roof beams add background sections to this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Mr. Krabs Hanging a Christmas Stocking Beside the Fireplace Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Mr. Krabs hanging a Christmas stocking beside a brick fireplace, with holly leaves and berries spread across the mantel above. One raised claw holds the stocking loop near its hook. The coloring sheet combines his broad clothing shapes with smaller brick outlines, leafy garland, and the stocking's cuff and patches.

pages.title: Mr. Krabs Dressed as an Elf Beside Christmas Presents and a Gingerbread House Coloring Page
pages.description: Mr. Krabs dresses as an elf beside Christmas presents and a gingerbread house in this printable coloring page, wearing a floppy hat and curled shoes. His outfit has a pointed collar, jagged hem, and broad belt. Ribbon bows, roof icing, and a round candy window provide smaller decorative sections on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Mr. Krabs Celebrating the Krusty Krab Anniversary with SpongeBob and Squidward Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Mr. Krabs celebrating the Krusty Krab anniversary with SpongeBob and Squidward, gathered around a cake beneath balloons and triangular bunting. Krabs raises both claws, SpongeBob lifts his fists, and Squidward claps. The coloring sheet has a single striped candle, scalloped icing, rope window panels, and wooden floorboards.

pages.title: SpongeBob Mr Krabs at Kelp Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: SpongeBob and Mr. Krabs stand in a kelp forest in this printable coloring page, smiling side by side beneath tall leafy fronds and a few rising bubbles. Mr. Krabs wears a collared shirt with a large dollar symbol, giving his broad claws and long eyestalks clear shapes beside SpongeBob.

pages.title: SpongeBob Mr Krabs at Treasure Cave Coloring Page
pages.description: SpongeBob and Mr. Krabs enjoy a treasure cave in this printable coloring page, raising a hand and claw while Mr. Krabs holds a small open chest before him. Piles of coins and faceted jewels cover the rocky ground, with a larger locked chest beneath the arched cave walls behind them.

pages.title: SpongeBob Mr Krabs at Weenie Hut General Coloring Page
pages.description: SpongeBob and Mr. Krabs stand at Weenie Hut General in this printable coloring page, smiling while SpongeBob holds a spatula and Mr. Krabs carries a patterned banknote. A large sign and striped awning frame the doorway behind them, with brick details around their broad character outlines and SpongeBob's anchor-marked hat.

pages.title: SpongeBob Mr Krabs at Boardwalk Coloring Page
pages.description: SpongeBob and Mr. Krabs pose on a boardwalk in this printable coloring page, smiling beside wooden railings with Mr. Krabs lifting one large claw behind his companion. Long rows of planks lead toward a small Krusty Krab kiosk, with streetlamps, distant visitors, gentle waves, and broad clouds beyond.

pages.title: SpongeBob Mr Krabs at Coral Reef Coloring Page
pages.description: SpongeBob and Mr. Krabs visit a coral reef in this printable coloring page, smiling as SpongeBob folds his arms and Mr. Krabs raises both large claws above his shirt. Branching coral and rounded patterned formations surround the pair, with little fish overhead and smooth pebbles across the sandy foreground.
